name: Kiko’s Seafood
notes: Branch-identity caveat: no address was given in the work list, and at least 4 similarly-named "Kiko's Place" seafood-truck branches operate in San Diego (Morena Blvd, Mission Valley/Hazard Center Dr, C St, Miramar Rd). Selected the Mission Valley/Hazard Center Dr Uber Eats listing ("Kikos Place Seafood (Mission Valley)") because casual public references (Reddit, TikTok, Facebook posts) consistently nickname that truck "Kiko's Seafood" - this is the best available match but not a certain address confirmation; flagging per house rule that one branch's menu must not silently stand in for another's. Source page carries two internal catalogs, "All Day" (77 items) and "Tuesday" (91 items, superset of All Day's sections); one item disagreed between them (OG Fish Taco: $4.99 in All Day vs $3.50 in Tuesday). Filed the larger, internally-consistent "Tuesday" catalog wholesale rather than merging - dishes below are those 91 rows as-is, including the $3.50 OG Fish Taco price from that catalog.

name: Minx Show Girls
notes: 3596 University Ave, San Diego CA 92104 is an adult-entertainment venue address (not a restaurant), confirmed via two independent sources naming two different, later, same-address occupants both now closed: Yelp shows "Star and Garter" (adult entertainment) CLOSED at 3596 University Avenue; MapQuest independently shows "Fantasys Showgirls" CLOSED at the same address. No restaurant or priced menu was ever associated with this address across any source found.

name: Trislers Wine Bar
notes: 8555 Station Village Ln, San Diego (Rio Vista / Mission Valley). Two independent sources agree: Yelp lists Trisler's Wine Bar as CLOSED at this address, and San Diego Reader's editorial listing for "The Remedy" states it opened in 2016 in the space formerly occupied by Trisler's Wine Bar - i.e. confirmed closed and replaced by a differently-named successor at the same address.

name: Silver Sands
notes: 995 Palm Avenue, Imperial Beach CA 91932. Independent local news (Imperial Beach News, Jan 2016) reports that IB Public House, a new gastropub, opened at the end of December in the former location of two prior bars, "Crystal Cove" and "Silver Sands" - confirming Silver Sands is closed and replaced by a differently-named successor at this address. Yelp currently shows "CORAL" sports bar at the same address, consistent with further turnover since.

name: Hi-C-Era
notes: 11541 Woodside Ave, Santee CA. Multiple independent sources agree: SanDiegoVille (independent local news) reports Deano's Pub East replacing Hi-C-Era Tavern; Yelp lists Hi-C-Era Tavern as CLOSED at the same address; a third outlet (whatnow.com) corroborates the same replacement. Confirmed closed and replaced by a differently-named successor at this address.
